kaikki_vikisozluk.e: كَوْكَب سَيَّار • (kawkab sayyār) m (plural كَوَاكِب سَيَّارَة (kawākib sayyāra) or كَوَاكِب سَيَّارَات (kawākib sayyārāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Calque of Ancient Greek ἀστὴρ πλανήτης (astḕr planḗtēs, “wandering star, planet”) as distinguished from the fixed stars, from كَوْكَب (kawkab, “star”) + سَيَّار (sayyār, “wanderer”).
s: Calque of Ancient Greek ἀστὴρ πλανήτης (astḕr planḗtēs, “wandering star, planet”)
